description.en: Rolling character text transition component library for expressive headings.
description.zh: 富有设计工程师张力的字符逐字翻滚与乱码解码文本过渡动效库。

content.en: Scritto is a typography-centric animation library that turns ordinary headings into expressive kinetic spectacles. Featuring rolling vertical letter cyclers, hacker-style decipher scrambled reveals, and smooth character morphs, it adds instant high-craft character to modern web titles.
content.zh: Scritto 是一套专注于现代西文字体排版与动力学文字特效的组件库。它将常见的静态标题转化为充满机械运动美感与黑客解码张力的交互景观，内置垂直字符翻转轮盘、字符乱码解密渐现以及字母弹性律动等多种高级动效形式。
